sheet:6:withdraw-drive-shaft.note: Reverse the shaft inset: release the tail-end gear and draw the shaft toward the nose with its near gear and bush. Nose-frame and drivetrain clearance in the finished model are untested.

sheet:8:withdraw-nose-axle.note: Clear the opposite retaining bush and the curved beam on the exit side. Carry the inset bush on the axle; check access to the opposite bush behind its beam.

sheet:8:withdraw-nose-axle-opposite.note: Mirrored option: carry the other bush, clearing the first bush and the curved beam on this exit side.

sheet:18:withdraw-rotor-stack.note: Pull toward the rotor with gear and rotor on the shaft. Separate the selected member on the bench. See step-18/side.png and step-18/axial.png.

sheet:19:lift-tail-with-light.note: Withdraw both pins from the beam together; keep the light and rotor on the tail. Gear disengagement and sweep need checking. Further separation is needed for any individual target.

sheet:22:carry-36.note: Clear the opposite blade; withdraw the axle toward the blade still attached. Separate the two on the bench.

sheet:22:carry-37.note: Clear the opposite blade; withdraw the axle toward the blade still attached. Separate the two on the bench.
